title: pre-edit.sh names .claude/rules/ as the source of .cursor/rules and sends seats to edit a generated copy
claim: pre-edit.sh's header (line 14) and its .cursor/rules refusal (lines 94-97) say the Cursor rules are generated from .claude/rules/ and tell the seat to edit that source and regenerate, but rules_sync.mjs generates both .claude/rules/ and .cursor/rules/ from dev/governance/rules/, so an edit made where the hook says is discarded by the regeneration (edit_reaches_cursor=0) and the hook lets that generated directory through (unguarded_generated=1).
mechanism: R9-RO-5 moved the canonical rules to dev/governance/rules/ and made .claude/rules/ a second generated output (tools/policy/rules_sync.mjs SRC/CLAUDE_OUT/CURSOR_OUT); the hook's comment, refusal text and guard still describe the pre-move layout, and its self-test pins the stale reading ('the SOURCE rule is allowed', .claude/rules/gate-scoping.md).

evidence.machine: box B12, x86_64 Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, 4 vCPU, Python 3.14.7, node v22.23.4
evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; a count, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: .claude/hooks/pre-edit.sh:decide (HPO_PRE_EDIT_PY block), driven end to end; tools/policy/rules_sync.mjs:SRC

perturbation.change: --perturb: replace .claude/rules/ with dev/governance/rules/ in the hook copy's refusal message (the one-line fix)

metric_definition: edit_reaches_cursor: 1 if a line planted in the dir the hook's refusal names as source survives rules_sync.mjs regeneration into .cursor/rules/<rule>.mdc, else 0
phenomenon_property: Every directory a hook comment or refusal names as the source of a generated file is the directory the generator reads, and every generator output directory is refused by the hook.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D5/s10/pre_edit_source.py --repo /home/user/heatpump_optimizer --ref 92d38ecb640bd462f2e19c0814d0f0b7df1ee692  (RESULT named_source, unguarded_generated over rules_sync.mjs's *_OUT dirs)

null_control.note: production code is allowed and .cursor/rules is still refused; only the named source and the .claude/rules guard are wrong

reproduction_steps: run the command; read RESULT named_source=.claude/rules/ and edit_reaches_cursor=0
proposed_fix_scope: pre-edit.sh lines 13-16 and 93-98: name dev/governance/rules/ as the source; refuse .claude/rules/** as generated too; flip the self-test case at line 146 to refuse and add a dev/governance/rules/ allow null control
